import sys
from threading import Condition
from unittest import mock
from alive_progress.core.hook_manager import buffered_hook_manager
from alive_progress.utils.terminal import get_term
orig_out, orig_err = sys.stdout, sys.stderr
hm = buffered_hook_manager('nice {}! ', lambda: 35, 0, Condition(), get_term())
hm.install()
with mock.patch('logging.StreamHandler.setStream'):
    hm.uninstall()
print('restored', sys.stdout is orig_out, sys.stderr is orig_err)
assert sys.stdout is orig_out and sys.stderr is orig_err, 'uninstall must restore original streams'
print('hook_uninstall_ok')
